description.html: The 30x20x25 cm terrarium has 600 cm² of floor and 15 liters of volume. That is a small area, so we recommend it as a first terrarium for juveniles, not as a permanent home for adult animals. The back has a 3D background, and ventilation is handled by a mesh vent.

A young leopard gecko or fat-tailed gecko has room here for a warm hide, a humid hide and a water dish, all within reach. A newly hatched corn snake feels safer in a small space and eats more regularly. For crested geckos, 25 cm of height suits only the youngest, because adults need a tall terrarium.

When the animal outgrows 30 cm of length, the 40x25x30 and 50x35x35 are the next sizes in our range. We can build the same model taller if you are getting it for a crested gecko. Making it to the dimensions you give us takes 7 to 14 days. We apply the film you select to the outer sides, and the background can resemble rock or bark.
